plugin.name: syluxium-decor
plugin._long: Window frames drawn from an xfwm4 theme, the same as the Xfce desktop's.

option.name: theme
option._long: The folder with the theme's pictures and themerc.

option.name: button_layout
option._long: xfwm4's button_layout: O menu, H hide, M maximize, C close, S shade, T stick; | separates the left and right sides.

option.name: ignore_views
option._long: Windows matching these criteria get no frame.
